kroger.name: Kroger
kroger.description: The Kroger Co. is an American retail corporation headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. It operates supermarkets and multi-department stores throughout the United States.

kodak.name: Kodak
kodak.description: Eastman Kodak Company is an American public company headquartered in Rochester, New York, and incorporated in New Jersey. It produces products related to its historic roots in film photography and is best known for bringing photographic film products to the mass market.

kazmunaygas.name: KazMunayGas
kazmunaygas.description: KazMunayGas is the state-owned oil and gas company of Kazakhstan. Founded in 2002, it was created by merging CJSC Kazakhoil and CJSC Oil&Gas Transportation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

kyocera.name: Kyocera
kyocera.description: Kyocera Corporation is a Japanese multinational ceramics and electronics manufacturer headquartered in Kyoto, Japan. Founded in 1959 as Kyoto Ceramic Company, Limited, it was renamed Kyocera in 1982. The company operates in the ceramics and electronics industry.

korian.name: Korian
korian.industry: Accommodation facility for dependent elderly people
korian.description: Korian is a French company specializing in nursing home care for the elderly, known as EHPAD in France. It operates nursing homes in six European countries. The company is based in France.

kubota.name: Kubota
kubota.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational based in Osaka, established in 1890. It manufactures a wide range of products including tractors, agricultural machinery, construction equipment, engines, and water treatment equipment.

kazakhmys.name: Kazakhmys
kazakhmys.description: Kazakhmys is a vertically integrated holding company focused on mining and non-ferrous metallurgy. Established in 1997 in Kazakhstan, it was divided in 2014 into Kazakhmys Corporation LLP and KAZ Minerals Plc.

kraft-heinz.name: Kraft Heinz
kraft-heinz.description: The Kraft Heinz Company is an American multinational food company co-headquartered in Chicago and Pittsburgh. It was formed in 2015 through the merger of Kraft Foods Group and the H.J. Heinz Company and markets packaged foods and beverages under several well-known brands.

konica-minolta.name: Konica Minolta
konica-minolta.description: Konica Minolta, Inc. is a Japanese multinational technology company headquartered in Tokyo. It manufactures business and industrial imaging products, optical devices, medical imaging products, and textile printers. The company sold its camera and photo operations to Sony in 2006.

kellogg-s.name: Kellogg's
kellogg-s.description: The Kellogg Company, known as Kellogg's, was an American multinational food manufacturing company headquartered in Battle Creek, Michigan. It produced breakfast cereals and convenience foods marketed under brands such as Corn Flakes, Rice Krispies, and Pringles.

knorr-bremse.name: Knorr-Bremse
knorr-bremse.description: Knorr-Bremse AG is a German manufacturer specializing in braking systems for rail and commercial vehicles since 1905. Its product range also includes intelligent door systems, control components, air conditioning systems for rail vehicles, and transmission control systems. The company is headquartered in Germany.

kawasaki-heavy-industries.name: Kawasaki Heavy Industries
kawasaki-heavy-industries.description: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It manufactures motorcycles, engines, heavy equipment, aerospace and defense equipment, rolling stock, ships, industrial robots, gas turbines, pumps, and boilers. The company is one of Japan's three major heavy industrial manufacturers.

krungthai-bank.name: Krungthai Bank
krungthai-bank.description: Krungthai Bank Public Company Limited is a Thai commercial bank with the Financial Institutions Development Fund as its majority shareholder. It is known by its initials KTB and operates under the Bank of Thailand. The bank's SWIFT code is KRTHTHBK.

kbr-inc.name: KBR, Inc.
kbr-inc.description: KBR, Inc. is a U.S.-based company operating in science, technology, and engineering sectors. It serves markets including aerospace, defense, industrial, intelligence, and energy. KBR supports NASA programs, international space agencies, and commercial partners.

kazatomprom.name: Kazatomprom
kazatomprom.description: Kazatomprom is a Kazakhstani company and the world’s largest producer and seller of natural uranium. It supplied over 40% of global primary uranium in 2019. The uranium produced is used worldwide for nuclear power generation.

korea-electric-power-corporation.name: Korea Electric Power Corporation
korea-electric-power-corporation.description: Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) is the largest electric utility in South Korea, responsible for electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. It develops electric power projects including nuclear, wind, and coal power. The South Korean government owns a majority share of KEPCO, which has an installed capacity of 83,235 MW.

kansai-electric-power-company.name: Kansai Electric Power Company
kansai-electric-power-company.description: The Kansai Electric Power Company, also known as Kanden, is an electric utility operating in the Kansai region of Japan. It provides electricity supply services within its operational area.

kddi.name: KDDI
kddi.description: KDDI Corporation is a Japanese telecommunications operator established in 2000 through the merger of DDI Corporation, KDD Corporation, and IDO Corporation. It provides long-distance, international, and mobile telecommunications services.

kasikornbank.name: Kasikornbank
kasikornbank.description: Kasikornbank, also known as KBank, is a banking group based in Thailand. Established in 1945 and formerly called Thai Farmers Bank, it has been listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since 1976. The bank changed its English name to Kasikornbank PCL in 2003.

komercni-banka-czech-republ.name: Komerční banka
komercni-banka-czech-republ.description: Komerční banka is a major Czech universal bank and the parent company of KB Group, part of Société Générale. It provides retail, corporate, and investment banking services in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. The bank serves over 1.6 million customers through 399 branches.

kesko.name: Kesko
kesko.description: Kesko Corporation is a Finnish retail conglomerate headquartered in Helsinki. It operates in grocery, building and technical trade, and car trade sectors across several Northern and Eastern European countries.

k-s.name: K+S
k-s.description: K+S AG is a German chemical company headquartered in Kassel. It is Europe's largest supplier of potash used in fertilizer and also produces other mineral fertilizers like magnesium and sulfur. The company operates mainly in Europe, North and South America.

kennametal.name: Kennametal
kennametal.description: Kennametal, Inc. is an American manufacturer of high-performance cutting tools and engineered components used in aerospace, defense, transportation, and oil and gas drilling industries. It serves a global customer base.

konecranes.name: Konecranes
konecranes.description: Konecranes Oyj is a Finnish company specializing in the manufacture and service of cranes and lifting equipment. It is headquartered in Hyvinkää, Finland. The company also services machine tools.

konzum.name: Konzum
konzum.description: Konzum is Croatia's largest supermarket chain with over 700 stores and more than 10,000 employees. It serves over 650,000 customers daily and is headquartered in Zagreb. Konzum is part of the Fortenova Group since 2019.

kinder-morgan.name: Kinder Morgan
kinder-morgan.description: Kinder Morgan, Inc. is an American energy infrastructure company specializing in owning and controlling oil and gas pipelines and terminals. It is based in the United States and operates within the petroleum industry.

kintetsu-world-express.name: Kintetsu World Express
kintetsu-world-express.description: Kintetsu World Express, Inc. is a major Japanese freight forwarding company and subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings. It provides air and sea freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and warehouse inventory management services.

konami.name: Konami
konami.description: Konami Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational entertainment company headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo. It develops and publishes video games and also produces trading cards, anime, pachinko and slot machines, and operates casinos and health clubs in Japan.

keysight-technologies.name: Keysight Technologies
keysight-technologies.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. is a global company headquartered in Santa Rosa, California. It manufactures electronic testing equipment and software used in designing and evaluating technologies across sectors like mobile communications, aerospace, automotive, and energy.

kinross-gold.name: Kinross Gold
kinross-gold.description: Kinross Gold Corporation is a Canadian gold and silver mining company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. Founded in 1993, it operates six active gold mines in Brazil, Mauritania, and the United States. It was ranked fifth among the top gold-mining companies in 2019.

kamet-steel.name: KAMET-STEEL
kamet-steel.description: Dnieper Metallurgical Combine is one of the largest metallurgical companies in Ukraine, located in Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. It operates alongside other major Ukrainian steel producers such as Kryvorizhstal and Illich Steel and Iron Works.

kongsberg-maritime.name: Kongsberg Maritime
kongsberg-maritime.description: Kongsberg Maritime is a Norwegian technology company formerly part of Kongsberg Gruppen. It delivers systems for positioning, navigation, surveying, and automation to merchant vessels and offshore installations, with products in dynamic positioning and marine automation.

kajima-corporation.name: Kajima Corporation
kajima-corporation.description: Kajima Corporation is one of the oldest and largest construction companies in Japan, founded in 1840. It is headquartered in Motoakasaka, Minato, Tokyo, and is known for its DIB-200 proposal. The company is publicly traded on four major Japanese stock exchanges.

kyowa-kirin.name: Kyowa Kirin
kyowa-kirin.description: Kyowa Kirin Co., Ltd. is a Japanese pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It operates under Kirin Holdings and was among the 40 largest pharmaceutical companies worldwide by revenue in 2012. The company is a member of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

kalinin-machine-building-plant.name: Kalinin Machine-Building Plant
kalinin-machine-building-plant.description: JSC Kalinin Machine-Building Plant, also known as ZiK or MZiK, is a Russian industrial company producing artillery and vehicles. It is part of the Almaz-Antey holding company.

kalashnikov-concern.name: Kalashnikov Concern
kalashnikov-concern.description: JSC Kalashnikov Concern is a Russian defense manufacturer headquartered in Izhevsk and Moscow. It produces a wide range of civilian and military weapons including rifles, machine guns, guided projectiles, and military robots.

kirov-plant.name: Kirov Plant
kirov-plant.description: The Kirov Plant is a major Russian mechanical engineering and agricultural machinery manufacturer based in St. Petersburg. Established in 1789, it originally produced cannonballs and now mainly manufactures Kirovets heavy tractors.

kao-corporation.name: Kao Corporation
kao-corporation.description: Kao Corporation is a Japanese global chemical and cosmetics company headquartered in Nihonbashi-Kayabacho, Chūō, Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the chemical and cosmetics industry.

kapsch.name: Kapsch
kapsch.description: The Kapsch Group is an international corporation headquartered in Vienna, Austria, specializing in telematics, information technology, and telecommunication. It operates in the information technology sector.

kemira.name: Kemira
kemira.description: Kemira Oyj is a chemical industry group headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. Established in 1920, it operates in Water Solutions, Packaging & Hygiene Solutions, and Fiber Essentials business areas.

kaman-corporation.name: Kaman Corporation
kaman-corporation.description: Kaman Corporation is an American aerospace company headquartered in Bloomfield, Connecticut. Founded in 1945, it initially focused on designing and manufacturing helicopters that set world records and achieved aviation firsts.

kureha.name: Kureha
kureha.description: Kureha Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer specializing in specialty chemicals, polymers, and agrichemicals.

krispy-kreme.name: Krispy Kreme
krispy-kreme.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. is an American multinational doughnut company and coffeehouse chain founded in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. The company was founded by Vernon Rudolph in 1937 and has undergone periods of public and private ownership.

king-long.name: King Long
king-long.description: King Long United Automotive Industry Co., Ltd, known as King Long, is a Chinese bus manufacturer headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian. Founded in 1988, it focuses on large and medium-sized coaches and light vans and was ranked among China's most influential brands in 2024.

kaspi-kz-joint-stock-company.name: Kaspi.kz Joint Stock Company
kaspi-kz-joint-stock-company.description: Kaspi.kz is a Kazakhstani unicorn company comprising several subsidiaries including Kaspi Shop LLP and Kaspi Bank JSC. It became one of the fastest-growing financial IT organizations in Europe and Eurasia in 2020.

kbenhavns-lufthavne.name: Københavns Lufthavne
kbenhavns-lufthavne.description: Københavns Lufthavne is a public limited company operating Copenhagen Airport and Roskilde Airport in Denmark. It previously held stakes in Newcastle International Airport and Aeropuertos del Sureste in Mexico.

klaviyo.name: Klaviyo
klaviyo.description: Klaviyo is a SaaS technology company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It provides an omnichannel CRM platform with AI features used by B2C brands for email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, social media marketing, customer service automation, and data management.

klepierre.name: Klépierre
klepierre.description: Klépierre S.A. is a French real estate investment trust and is the second-largest publicly traded mall operator in Europe.

kimco-realty.name: Kimco Realty
kimco-realty.description: Kimco Realty Corporation is a real estate investment trust based in Jericho, New York. It invests in shopping centers across the Contiguous United States and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. The company focuses on retail real estate assets.

kn-energies-ab.name: KN Energies, AB
kn-energies-ab.description: KN Energies is a liquid energy product and LNG terminals operator based in Klaipėda, Lithuania. Founded in 1994, it operates several terminals in Lithuania and LNG terminals in Brazil and Germany, and develops LNG projects worldwide.

kadokawa-shoten.name: Kadokawa Shoten
kadokawa-shoten.description: Kadokawa Shoten is a Japanese publisher and division of Kadokawa Corporation based in Tokyo. It publishes manga, light novels, and entertainment magazines, and has expanded into multimedia including video games and films. It became an internal division of Kadokawa Corporation in 2013.

kalray.name: Kalray
kalray.description: Kalray is a French fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Montbonnot, France. It operates in the manufacture of electronic components sector.

kinnevik-ab.name: Kinnevik AB
kinnevik-ab.description: Kinnevik AB is a Swedish investment company founded in 1936 by the Stenbeck, Klingspor, and von Horn families. It operates in the investment industry.

kimia-farma.name: Kimia Farma
kimia-farma.description: PT Kimia Farma Tbk is an Indonesian pharmaceutical producer and distributor based in Jakarta. It operates within Indonesia's pharmaceutical industry.

kegoc.name: KEGOC
kegoc.description: The Kazakhstan Electricity Grid Operating Company (KEGOC) is a state joint-stock company based in Astana, Kazakhstan. Established in 1997, it operates in the power engineering sector. KEGOC manages electricity grid operations within Kazakhstan.

kyndryl.name: Kyndryl
kyndryl.description: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New York City. It designs, builds, and manages infrastructure services and also provides business advisory services.

kgi-financial-holding.name: KGI Financial Holding
kgi-financial-holding.description: KGI Financial Holding Co., Ltd. is a financial holding corporation based in Taiwan. Founded by Jeffrey Koo Sr. and the Koo Family, it operates key subsidiaries including CDIB Capital Group, KGI Securities, KGI Bank, and KGI Life. The company is currently chaired by Angelo Koo.

king-s-town-bank.name: King's Town Bank
king-s-town-bank.description: King's Town Bank is a Taiwanese commercial bank established in 1948. It was previously known as the Tainan Small and Medium Business Bank.

kader.name: Kader
kader.description: Kader Industrial Company Limited was founded in Hong Kong in 1948 and is currently known as Kader Holdings Company Limited. It was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 1985. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sector.

kakaku-com-inc.name: Kakaku.com, Inc.
kakaku-com-inc.description: Kakaku.com, Inc. is a Japanese company that operates Kakaku.com, also known as Price.com, a comparison shopping website, along with other services.

kaneka-corporation.name: Kaneka Corporation
kaneka-corporation.description: Kaneka Corporation is a Japanese international chemical manufacturing company headquartered in Osaka. Founded in 1949, it produces chemical products such as functional resin, foam resin, and synthetic fibers.

kewpie-corporation.name: Kewpie Corporation
kewpie-corporation.description: Kewpie Corporation is a Japanese company known for producing Kewpie mayonnaise, a brand with a unique flavor attributed to its use of egg yolks instead of whole eggs. The mayonnaise is associated with the tamago sando, an egg salad sandwich sold in 7-Eleven Japan convenience stores.

krakatau-steel.name: Krakatau Steel
krakatau-steel.description: PT Krakatau Steel (Persero) Tbk is the largest steel maker in Indonesia, headquartered in Cilegon, Banten. Its factory is located on a 280-hectare plot near the Sunda Strait, close to the Krakatoa volcano and island, from which the company takes its name.

koikeya.name: Koikeya
koikeya.description: Koikeya is a Japanese snack food manufacturer known as the second-largest producer of potato chips in Japan as of 2019.

kingdee.name: Kingdee
kingdee.description: Kingdee International Software Group is a Chinese cloud computing and software company headquartered in Shenzhen. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and is a leader in the Chinese software industry.

kansai-paint.name: Kansai Paint
kansai-paint.description: Kansai Paint Co., Ltd. is a Japanese chemical company based in Osaka. Its main products include automotive, industrial, and decorative coatings.

karmarts.name: Karmarts
karmarts.description: Karmarts, formerly DiStar Electric Corporation, is a Thai company that imports and distributes cosmetic goods and beauty products. It previously manufactured and distributed electronic goods under the DiStar brand.

kikkoman.name: Kikkoman
kikkoman.description: Kikkoman Corporation is a Japanese food manufacturer known for soy sauce, seasonings, beverages, and restaurant management. As of 2002, it was the world's largest soy sauce producer and promotes international exchange of food culture.

kawai-musical-instruments.name: Kawai Musical Instruments
kawai-musical-instruments.description: Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a musical instrument manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan. Founded in August 1927, it is known for producing grand pianos, upright pianos, digital pianos, electronic keyboards, and synthesizers.

kingsoft.name: Kingsoft
kingsoft.description: Kingsoft Corporation is a Chinese software company based in Beijing. It operates subsidiaries in video game development, mobile internet apps, cloud storage, and office software. Its popular game JX Online 3 was launched in 2009.

klabin.name: Klabin
klabin.description: Klabin is a Brazilian paper producing, exporting, and recycling company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the largest paper producer and exporter in Brazil, focusing on pulp, packaging paper, corrugated cardboard, and industrial sacks. The company is controlled by Klabin Irmãos & Cia and NIBLAK Participações S/A.

kimball-international.name: Kimball International
kimball-international.description: Kimball International, Inc. is an American company consisting of furniture brands such as Kimball and National. It is the successor to W.W. Kimball and Company, once the world's largest piano and organ manufacturer.

kelly-services.name: Kelly Services
kelly-services.description: Kelly Services, Inc. is an American multinational office staffing company headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It provides employee placement across various sectors and offers professional services including HR consulting and recruitment.

kohlberg-kravis-roberts.name: Kohlberg Kravis Roberts
kohlberg-kravis-roberts.description: KKR & Co. Inc., also known as Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co., is an American investment firm serving institutional investors, wealth investors, family offices, and companies across various industries. It operates in asset management, insurance, and Strategic Holdings. KKR is one of the world's largest alternative asset management firms.

koei-tecmo-holdings.name: Koei Tecmo Holdings
koei-tecmo-holdings.description: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese holding company in the video game, amusement, and anime industries. It was created in 2009 by merging Koei and Tecmo. The company and its subsidiaries were known as Tecmo Koei until 2014 when the name was reversed to Koei Tecmo.

kpit-technologies.name: KPIT Technologies
kpit-technologies.description: KPIT Technologies Ltd is an Indian multinational providing engineering research and development services to automotive companies. Headquartered in Pune, it operates development centers in Europe, USA, Brazil, Japan, China, and India.

keppel-ltd.name: Keppel Ltd.
keppel-ltd.description: Keppel Ltd. is a Singaporean company headquartered in Keppel Bay Tower, HarbourFront, with operations in over 20 countries. Since 2024, it has been organized into four main business platforms: Infrastructure, Real Estate, Connectivity, and Fund Management & Investment.

kinki-sharyo.name: Kinki Sharyo
kinki-sharyo.description: Kinki Sharyo Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of railroad vehicles based in Osaka. Founded in 1920 and renamed in 1945, it produces rolling stock including Shinkansen high-speed trains and is an affiliate of Kintetsu Corporation.

komatsu-limited.name: Komatsu Limited
komatsu-limited.description: Komatsu Ltd. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It manufactures construction, mining, forestry, and military heavy equipment, as well as diesel engines and industrial equipment. The company was founded in 1921 in Komatsu, Ishikawa Prefecture.

knoll.name: Knoll
knoll.description: Knoll is an American company that manufactures office and storage systems, furniture, textiles, and accessories. Its KnollStudio division produces licensed furniture designed by renowned architects and designers. Over 40 of its designs are part of the permanent collection at the Museum of Modern Art in New York City.

koss-corporation.name: Koss Corporation
koss-corporation.description: Koss Corporation is a Milwaukee, Wisconsin-based company that manufactures headphones. It is notable for creating the first high-fidelity stereo headphones in 1958.

k-hovnanian-homes.name: K. Hovnanian Homes
k-hovnanian-homes.description: Hovnanian Enterprises, Inc. is an American real estate company involved in marketing homes, including design, construction, and sales. It works with individual detached housing as well as townhouses, condominiums, and retirement homes. The company operates in the United States.

kadant.name: Kadant
kadant.description: Kadant Inc. is a multinational company supporting papermaking, paper recycling, wood processing, and material handling industries. Established in 1991 as a subsidiary of Thermo Electron, it was fully spun out and renamed Kadant in 2001. The company operates in Asia, Europe, North America, and South America.

kcg-holdings.name: KCG Holdings
kcg-holdings.description: KCG Holdings, Inc. was an American global financial services firm engaged in market making, high-frequency trading, electronic execution, and institutional sales and trading. It was formed in 2013 from the merger of Knight Capital Group and GETCO Holding Company.

kopin-corporation.name: Kopin Corporation
kopin-corporation.description: The Kopin Corporation is an electronics manufacturer based in Westborough, Massachusetts. It is known for its microdisplay devices and application-specific optical solutions for defense, enterprise, medical, and consumer mobile electronics. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

kandi-technologies.name: Kandi Technologies
kandi-technologies.description: Kandi Technology Group, Inc. is a Chinese manufacturer of batteries and electric vehicles founded in 2002 in Jinhua, Zhejiang. The company was founded by Hu Xiaoming and is listed on the NASDAQ stock exchange under the ticker symbol KNDI.

knightscope.name: Knightscope
knightscope.description: Knightscope, Inc. is a security camera and robotics company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It designs and deploys autonomous robots for monitoring public areas using self-driving technology and sensors.

kadokawa-corporation.name: Kadokawa Corporation
kadokawa-corporation.description: Kadokawa Corporation, formerly Kadokawa Dwango Corporation, is a Japanese conglomerate based in Fujimi, Chiyoda, Tokyo. It operates in the media and entertainment industry. The company is headquartered in Japan.

kansas-city-life-insurance-company.name: Kansas City Life Insurance Company
kansas-city-life-insurance-company.description: Kansas City Life Insurance Company is a public insurance company established in 1895 and located in Kansas City, Missouri. It markets individual life, annuity, and group products through agencies in 48 US states and the District of Columbia. It also offers investment options through its subsidiary, Sunset Financial Services.

kobe-steel.name: Kobe Steel
kobe-steel.description: Kobe Steel, Ltd. is a major Japanese steel manufacturer headquartered in Chūō-ku, Kobe. The Kobe Steel Group operates under the unified brand name Kobelco. The company is part of Japan's iron and steel industry.

keybank.name: KeyBank
keybank.description: KeyBank is an American regional bank headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. Formed by a 1994 merger, it operates nearly 1,000 branches and over 1,200 ATMs across multiple US regions including the Midwest and Pacific Northwest. It is one of the largest banks in the United States.

key-tronic.name: Key Tronic
key-tronic.description: Key Tronic Corporation is a US-based technology company founded in 1969. It specializes in printed circuit board and full product assembly, offering design and assembly services for various electronic and household products. It is among the ten largest contract manufacturers providing electronic manufacturing services in the US.

kimberly-clark.name: Kimberly-Clark
kimberly-clark.description: Kimberly-Clark Corporation is an American multinational consumer goods company producing mostly paper-based products. It manufactures sanitary paper products and surgical and medical instruments. Its brands include Kleenex, Kotex, Cottonelle, Scott, Andrex, Wypall, KimWipes, and Huggies.

kinepolis.name: Kinepolis
kinepolis.description: The Kinepolis Group is a Belgian cinema chain operating 110 theaters in Europe and North America. It is the third-largest cinema chain in Europe.

koppers.name: Koppers
koppers.description: Koppers is a global chemical and materials company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. Its headquarters is located in the art-deco 1920s skyscraper known as the Koppers Tower.

kunlun-energy.name: Kunlun Energy
kunlun-energy.description: Kunlun Energy Company Limited is a Hong Kong-listed company engaged in exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas. Its parent company is China National Petroleum Corporation, and it operates in multiple countries including China and Kazakhstan.

kolon-industries.name: KOLON Industries
kolon-industries.description: Kolon Industries is a South Korean chemical and textile manufacturer founded in 1957 as Korea Nylon Inc. It produces chemicals, materials, and fashion products. In 2015, it opened South Korea's first shopping mall built with shipping containers and has a US subsidiary selling polyester and nylon films.

kite-pharma.name: Kite Pharma
kite-pharma.description: Kite Pharma, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Santa Monica, California. It develops cancer immunotherapy products focusing on genetically engineered autologous CAR T cell therapy. Founded in 2009, it was acquired by Gilead Sciences in 2017.

kose-corporation.name: KOSÉ Corporation
kose-corporation.description: Kosé Holdings Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures cosmetics, personal care, and beauty products. It is headquartered in Chūō, Tokyo.

kenon-holdings-ltd.name: Kenon Holdings Ltd
kenon-holdings-ltd.description: Kenon Holdings is a public corporation spun off from Israel Corporation and traded on the New York and Tel Aviv Stock Exchanges. It is owned by Israeli businessman Idan Ofer and controls Israel Corp's investments in companies such as Qoros. The company is based in Israel.

kedawung-setia-industrial.name: Kedawung Setia Industrial
kedawung-setia-industrial.description: Kedawung Setia Industrial is an Indonesian home appliance manufacturer based in Surabaya, East Java. Founded in 1973, it mainly produces enamelware products.

kintetsu-group-holdings.name: Kintetsu Group Holdings
kintetsu-group-holdings.description: Kintetsu Group Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese railway holding company. It primarily owns Kintetsu Railway, Kintetsu World Express, Kintetsu Department Store, and 141 other corporations collectively known as Kintetsu Group.

kraton-polymers.name: Kraton Polymers
kraton-polymers.description: Kraton Polymers manufactures high-performance elastomers used as synthetic replacements for rubber. These polymers provide properties similar to natural rubber but with increased resistance to heat, weathering, and chemicals. Kraton is a trade name for these elastomers.

kuala-lumpur-kepong-berhad.name: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad
kuala-lumpur-kepong-berhad.description: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK) is a Malaysian multinational company primarily engaged in plantation activities, with plantations in Malaysia and Indonesia. It has diversified into manufacturing, property development, and retailing, and is Malaysia's third-largest palm oil producer.

kioxia.name: Kioxia
kioxia.description: Kioxia is a Japanese semiconductor memory and data-storage group headquartered in Tokyo. It is led by the publicly traded holding company Kioxia Holdings Corporation. Its principal subsidiary develops, manufactures, and sells NAND flash memory, solid-state drives, and related storage products.

kamaz.name: Kamaz
kamaz.description: KAMAZ is a Russian manufacturer of trucks, buses, and engines headquartered in Naberezhnye Chelny. It specializes in producing heavy vehicles and related powertrain components.

kabuki-za.name: Kabuki-za
kabuki-za.description: Kabuki-za is the principal theater in Tokyo, Japan, for the traditional kabuki drama form. It is located in the Ginza district and serves as a key venue for this classical Japanese performing art.

keurig-dr-pepper.name: Keurig Dr Pepper
keurig-dr-pepper.description: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. is an American beverage conglomerate with dual headquarters in Massachusetts and Texas. It was formed in 2018 through the merger of Keurig Green Mountain and Dr Pepper Snapple Group.

kaga-create.name: Kaga Create
kaga-create.description: Kaga Create Co., Ltd., formerly known as Naxat Soft, was a Japan-based video game developing and publishing division of Kaga Electronics. The company operated in the video game industry and was based in Japan.

kerry-properties.name: Kerry Properties
kerry-properties.description: Kerry Properties Limited is a listed company engaged in property development in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and the Asia Pacific region. It also undertakes infrastructure projects and hotel ownership and operations in mainland China. The company is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.

kingboard-holdings.name: Kingboard Holdings
kingboard-holdings.description: Kingboard Holdings Limited, formerly Kingboard Chemical Holdings Limited, is a manufacturer of laminates and other chemical products. Headquartered in Shatin, New Territories, Hong Kong, it operates over 60 manufacturing facilities in China and Thailand and invests surplus funds in real estate globally.

kiatnakin-phatra-bank.name: Kiatnakin Phatra Bank
kiatnakin-phatra-bank.description: Kiatnakin Phatra Bank is a full-service bank based in Bangkok, Thailand. Founded in January 1971, it has expanded to 52 branches and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. The bank is included in the SET50 Index.

kakao-games.name: Kakao Games
kakao-games.description: Kakao Games Corp. is a South Korean video game publisher and subsidiary of Kakao. It specializes in developing and publishing games on PC, mobile, and VR platforms. The company is represented by Namgoong Hoon and Cho Gye-hyun.

korea-new-network.name: Korea New Network
korea-new-network.description: The Korea New Network (KNN) is the largest regional free-to-air commercial broadcaster based in Centum City, Busan, South Korea. Affiliated with SBS, it began official broadcasts in 1995 and produces about 35 percent of its own programming as of 2011.

kt-corporation.name: KT Corporation
kt-corporation.description: KT Corporation, formerly Korea Telecom, is a South Korean telecommunications company and mobile network operator. It is a major wireless carrier in South Korea.

korea-aerospace-industries.name: Korea Aerospace Industries
korea-aerospace-industries.description: Korea Aerospace Industries, Ltd. is a South Korean aerospace and defense manufacturer. It was originally a joint venture of Daewoo Heavy Industries' aerospace division, Samsung Aerospace, and Hyundai Space and Aircraft. The company became more independent in 1999 after acquiring aerospace interests from its founding members.

korea-gas-corporation.name: Korea Gas Corporation
korea-gas-corporation.description: The Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS) is a South Korean state-owned natural gas company established in 1983. It operates five LNG regasification terminals and pipelines supplying 216 cities and counties, making it one of the world's largest buyers of liquefied natural gas.

kb-kookmin-bank.name: KB Kookmin Bank
kb-kookmin-bank.description: Kookmin Bank, also known as KB Kookmin Bank, is a bank headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It was the largest bank in Korea and ranked 60th largest worldwide as of 2017. The name is a contraction of Citizens National Bank, a former English name.

kg-steel.name: KG Steel
kg-steel.description: KG Steel Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational corporation that produces steel-related and cold-rolled products. The company operates in the iron and steel industry.

kanadevia-corporation.name: Kanadevia Corporation
kanadevia-corporation.description: Kanadevia Corporation, formerly Hitachi Zosen Corporation, is a major Japanese industrial and engineering corporation. It produces waste treatment plants, industrial plants, precision machinery, steel mill process equipment, construction machinery, tunnel boring machines, marine engines, and power plants.

kt-skylife.name: KT Skylife
kt-skylife.description: KT SkyLife is a satellite broadcasting provider based in South Korea. It operates as a subsidiary of KT Corporation.

kb-home.name: KB Home
kb-home.description: KB Home is an American homebuilding company founded in 1957 in Detroit, Michigan. It was the first home builder traded on the New York Stock Exchange. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, with plans to move to Tempe, Arizona in 2027.

kec-international.name: KEC International
kec-international.description: KEC International Limited is an Indian multinational company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's second largest manufacturer of electric power transmission towers and a major EPC company in power transmission, distribution, railways, solar, and infrastructure sectors. It operates across India, SAARC, EAP, Africa, Middle East, and the Americas.

kepco-engineering-construction-company.name: KEPCO Engineering & Construction Company
kepco-engineering-construction-company.description: KEPCO Engineering & Construction Company is a South Korean power plant design and engineering firm established in 1975. It designs, engineers, and constructs nuclear and fossil power plants and operates as a subsidiary of Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO).

kagome.name: Kagome
kagome.description: Kagome Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that manufactures and distributes tomato-based foods as well as fruit and vegetable juices. It operates in the agriculture and food industry in Japan.

kaiser-aluminum.name: Kaiser Aluminum
kaiser-aluminum.description: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation is an American aluminum producer. It originated as a spinoff from Kaiser Aluminum and Chemicals Corporation, which itself was formed after the renaming of Permanente Metals Corporation.

kalbe-farma.name: Kalbe Farma
kalbe-farma.description: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk, known as Kalbe, is an Indonesian pharmaceutical, healthcare, and nutrition company established in 1966. It has grown through acquisitions and produces a range of products including prescription drugs, OTC drugs, energy drinks, and nutrition products.

kelso-company.name: Kelso & Company
kelso-company.description: Kelso & Company is an American private equity firm based in New York City. It focuses on leveraged buyouts, recapitalizations, and growth capital transactions across sectors including communication, manufacturing, and restaurants.

kemper-corporation.name: Kemper Corporation
kemper-corporation.description: Kemper Corporation is an American insurance provider headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It offers insurance products to individuals, families, and businesses.

key-energy-services.name: Key Energy Services
key-energy-services.description: Key Energy Services is an American company providing oilfield services. It operates within the oilfield service industry.

khon-kaen-sugar.name: Khon Kaen Sugar
khon-kaen-sugar.description: Khon Kaen Sugar (KSL) is a sugar-manufacturing company based in Thailand. Its corporate headquarters are located in Bangkok, with principal manufacturing facilities in Khon Kaen, northeastern Thailand. The company operates in the food industry.

kid-brands.name: Kid Brands
kid-brands.description: Kid Brands, Inc. was a company that designed, developed, and distributed infant and juvenile branded products. These products were sold through various retail channels worldwide, including mass market, specialty, and e-commerce retailers. The company was based in the United States.

kintetsu-department-store.name: Kintetsu Department Store
kintetsu-department-store.description: Kintetsu Department Store Co., Ltd. is a department store chain headquartered in Abenosuji Itchome, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan. It operates in the Kansai region of Japan, serving retail customers.

kirkland-s.name: Kirkland's
kirkland-s.description: Kirkland's, Inc. is an American retail chain based in Brentwood, Tennessee. It sells home decor, furniture, textiles, accessories, and gifts through 317 stores across 35 states and an e-commerce website.

kitty-hawk-aircargo.name: Kitty Hawk Aircargo
kitty-hawk-aircargo.description: Kitty Hawk Aircargo was an American cargo airline based at Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport and in Grapevine, Texas. It operated domestic scheduled overnight freight services and air charter services, with a hub at Fort Wayne International Airport.

kogan-com.name: Kogan.com
kogan-com.description: Kogan.com is an Australian-Tasmanian portfolio of retail and services businesses founded in 2006 by Ruslan Kogan. Its operations include retail, marketplace, mobile, internet, insurance, travel, money, cars, energy, and other brands.

kona-grill.name: Kona Grill
kona-grill.description: Kona Grill, Inc. is a casual restaurant company based in Denver, Colorado, serving American cuisine, sushi, and cocktails. It operates around 40 restaurants in 23 U.S. states and three international franchise locations. In 2019, it was purchased by One Hospitality Group.

kongzhong.name: Kongzhong
kongzhong.description: Kongzhong Corporation is a Chinese company providing value-added services including video games via the Internet and mobile networks. Its offerings include mobile web content, ring tones, ringback tones, mobile games, and Internet games.

konka-group.name: Konka Group
konka-group.description: Konka Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese electronics manufacturer headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. The company is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. It produces various electronics products.

kepco-plant-service-engineering-co.name: KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering Co.
kepco-plant-service-engineering-co.description: KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering Co., Ltd. is a South Korean public enterprise established in 1974. It is a subsidiary of KEPCO and provides electronic power and industrial facilities. The company operates in the engineering sector.

kornit-digital.name: Kornit Digital
kornit-digital.description: Kornit Digital Ltd. is an Israeli-American manufacturing company producing high-speed industrial inkjet printers, pigmented ink, and chemical products. It serves the garment, apparel, home goods, textile accessories, and decorating industries.

kumagai-gumi.name: Kumagai Gumi
kumagai-gumi.description: Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd. is a Japanese construction company founded in Fukui, Fukui Prefecture. While its registered headquarters remain in Fukui, the actual head office is located in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

kumari-bank-limited.name: Kumari Bank Limited
kumari-bank-limited.description: Kumari Bank Limited is the fifteenth commercial bank in Nepal, launched in 2001. At its establishment, it had an authorized capital of NPR 2 billion and a paid-up capital of NPR 1.83 billion.

kura-sushi.name: Kura Sushi
kura-sushi.description: Kura Sushi, Inc. is a Japanese conveyor belt sushi restaurant chain headquartered in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture. As of October 2023, it operates 543 locations in Japan, 56 in Taiwan, and 69 in the United States, making it the second largest sushi chain in Japan.

kyodo-public-relations.name: Kyodo Public Relations
kyodo-public-relations.description: Kyodo Public Relations is the largest independent public relations agency in Japan. Founded in 1964 by Sakae Ohashi, it mainly serves enterprises and was listed on the JASDAQ stock market in 2005.

kingfisher-plc.name: Kingfisher plc
kingfisher-plc.description: Kingfisher plc is a British multinational retailing company headquartered in London, England. It operates in the retail sector.

kudelski-group.name: Kudelski Group
kudelski-group.description: Kudelski SA is a Swiss company that sells digital television access and management systems, content protection, cybersecurity, IoT products, and public access infrastructure. It is headquartered in Cheseaux-sur-Lausanne, Switzerland, and Phoenix, Arizona. Its first successful product was the Nagra tape recorder, developed by founder Stefan Kudelski.

kyushu-electric-power.name: Kyushu Electric Power
kyushu-electric-power.description: Kyūshū Electric Power Co., Inc., abbreviated as Kyūden, is a Japanese energy company providing power to seven prefectures and parts of Hiroshima Prefecture. It operates in the electric power industry.

kobe-electric-railway.name: Kobe Electric Railway
kobe-electric-railway.description: The Kobe Electric Railway Co., Ltd., often called Shintetsu, is a Japanese private railway company operating in Kobe and surrounding cities. It is a subsidiary of the Hankyu Hanshin Toho Group.

kirkland-lake-gold.name: Kirkland Lake Gold
kirkland-lake-gold.description: Kirkland Lake Gold Inc. was a Canadian gold mining company based in Toronto. It owned and operated several gold mines in Canada and Australia before merging into Agnico Eagle in 2021.

kindred-healthcare.name: Kindred Healthcare
kindred-healthcare.description: Kindred Healthcare is a healthcare company operating long-term acute-care hospitals and providing rehabilitation services across the United States.

kontoor-brands.name: Kontoor Brands
kontoor-brands.description: Kontoor Brands is an American company marketing clothing under the Wrangler and Helly Hansen brands. It also operates VF Outlet stores.

kohl-s.name: Kohl's
kohl-s.description: Kohl's Corporation is an American department store retail chain operating stores in every U.S. state except Hawaii. Founded by Maxwell Kohl in 1927 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, it expanded from a grocery store to department stores starting in 1962. The company went public in 1992 after several ownership changes.

kalleh-dairy.name: Kalleh Dairy
kalleh-dairy.description: Kalleh Dairy is an Iranian dairy, food, and drink company headquartered in Amol, Iran.

kongsberg-automotive.name: Kongsberg Automotive
kongsberg-automotive.description: Kongsberg Automotive Holding ASA is a manufacturer of automotive parts based in Norway. It operates in the automotive industry providing components for vehicles.

kraz.name: KrAZ
kraz.description: KrAZ is a Ukrainian factory located in Kremenchuk that produces trucks and special-purpose heavy-duty off-road vehicles. It operates as a holding company combining several factories and was nationalized by the Ukrainian government under martial law in 2022.

kenya-red-cross-society.name: Kenya Red Cross Society
kenya-red-cross-society.description: The Kenya Red Cross was established in 1965 and is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. It supports various projects including famine relief, blood services, first aid, disaster and emergency services, and education in Kenya.

krasnoyarsk-dam.name: Krasnoyarsk Dam
krasnoyarsk-dam.description: The Krasnoyarsk Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Yenisey River near Krasnoyarsk, Russia. Constructed between 1956 and 1972, it supplies about 6,000 MW of electricity, primarily to the KrAZ, with power and aluminum plants controlled by RUSAL.

kayaba.name: Kayaba
kayaba.description: KYB Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese automotive company. Further details about its products or services are not provided in the summary.

kiwoom-securities.name: Kiwoom Securities
kiwoom-securities.description: Kiwoom Securities is a South Korean financial services company based in Seoul. Founded in 2000, it acts as a broker for foreign and domestic stock and futures exchanges and provides financial services including investment, risk management, asset management, and investment strategy research.

korea-district-heating-corporation.name: Korea District Heating Corporation
korea-district-heating-corporation.description: The Korea District Heating Corporation is a South Korean district heating company headquartered in Seongnam. Established in 1985 as a statutory corporation, it promotes energy conservation and efficient district heating, supplying services to 1.3 million households as of 2015.

korea-zinc-co.name: Korea Zinc Co.
korea-zinc-co.description: Korea Zinc Company, Ltd. is a South Korean non-ferrous metal smelter headquartered in Seoul. It is a leading refined zinc producer and manufactures 18 types of metals and chemical products from various raw materials including zinc and lead concentrates.

kaz-minerals.name: KAZ Minerals
kaz-minerals.description: KAZ Minerals is a copper producer operating in Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan. The company focuses on copper mining and developing new copper mining projects in these countries.

kaonmedia.name: KAONMEDIA
kaonmedia.description: Kaon Media is a South Korean technology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of digital connectivity devices and residential gateways. It serves pay-TV operators, broadband operators, and telcos. The company is based in South Korea.

kazanorgsintez.name: Kazanorgsintez
kazanorgsintez.description: PJSC Kazanorgsintez is one of Russia's largest chemical companies and the country's largest polyethylene producer. It is based in Kazan, Tatarstan, and operates in the chemical industry.

kuzbassenergo.name: Kuzbassenergo
kuzbassenergo.description: Kuzbassenergo OAO is a Russian joint-stock company specializing in energy distribution. It is headquartered in Barnaul, Altai Krai, Russia. The company is controlled by Siberian Energy Investments Ltd., which is linked to Andrey Melnichenko's Donalink Ltd.

kapstone.name: Kapstone
kapstone.description: KapStone Paper & Packaging was an American pulp and paper company based in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 2005 as Stone, it became a subsidiary of WestRock Company in November 2018.

kenneth-cole-productions.name: Kenneth Cole Productions
kenneth-cole-productions.description: Kenneth Cole Productions, Inc. is an American fashion house founded in 1982 by Kenneth Cole. It operates in the retail sector.

keshavarzi-bank.name: Keshavarzi Bank
keshavarzi-bank.description: Bank Keshavarzi, also known as Agribank, is a major Iranian bank specializing in agricultural finance. Established in 1933, it operates over 1800 branches nationwide and finances nearly 70% of Iran's agricultural sector.

kumho-engineering-and-construction.name: Kumho Engineering and Construction
kumho-engineering-and-construction.description: Kumho Engineering and Construction is a South Korean company specializing in civil engineering and construction. It is based in South Korea.

kvrner.name: Kværner
kvrner.description: Kværner was a Norwegian engineering and construction services company that operated from 1853 until 2005. It was based in Norway and specialized in engineering and construction services. The company ceased to exist in 2005.

kiro-o-games.name: Kiro'o Games
kiro-o-games.description: Kiro'o Games, also known as Kiro'o Studios, is a privately held video game, animation, development, and publishing company headquartered in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

kitea.name: KITEA
kitea.description: Kitea is a Moroccan furniture and home decoration retail brand founded in 1993 by Amine Benkirane. It operates 33 stores across 16 Moroccan cities and has expanded into Sub-Saharan Africa.

koutoubia-brand.name: Koutoubia (brand)
koutoubia-brand.description: Koutoubia is a Moroccan agri-food company known for producing processed meats and charcuterie. Founded in 1985 in Mohammédia by Mohamed Belghiti Khennoussi, it was later acquired by entrepreneur Tahar Bimezzagh.

kaya-airlines.name: Kaya Airlines
kaya-airlines.description: Kaya Airlines is a regional airline based in Mozambique. It operates from its base at Maputo International Airport, serving regional routes within the country.

kano-river-project.name: Kano River Project
kano-river-project.description: The Kano River Project is a large-scale integrated agricultural land use development in Northern Nigeria. It is a modern irrigation project developed under the Hadejia-Juma’are River Basin Development Authority. The project supports agricultural activities in the region.

keystone-bank-limited.name: Keystone Bank Limited
keystone-bank-limited.description: Keystone Bank Limited is a commercial bank operating in Nigeria. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria, the national banking regulator. The bank provides various banking services within the country.

kiira-motors-corporation.name: Kiira Motors Corporation
kiira-motors-corporation.description: Kiira Motors Corporation is a state-owned automotive manufacturer in Uganda established to develop the country's automotive industry and commercialize the Kiira Electric Vehicle Project. The government holds the majority equity, with Makerere University as a minority partner.

kenya-electricity-generating-company.name: Kenya Electricity Generating Company
kenya-electricity-generating-company.description: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC (KenGen) is a government enterprise responsible for electricity production in Kenya. It is the largest electric power producer in the country, generating over 60% of the electricity consumed.

kenya-power-and-lighting-company.name: Kenya Power and Lighting Company
kenya-power-and-lighting-company.description: Kenya Power and Lighting Company, also known as Kenya Power or KPLC, is a public liability company that transmits, distributes, and retails electricity throughout Kenya. It operates in the electrical industry and serves customers nationwide.

kantanka-automobile.name: Kantanka Automobile
kantanka-automobile.description: Kantanka Automobile is a Ghanaian automotive company that designs, manufactures, assembles, and sells luxury cars. Established in 1994 by Kwadwo Safo Kantanka, it produces vehicles using over 75% local components. The company manufactured its first SUV, the Onantefo, in 2006.

koni-store.name: Koni Store
koni-store.description: Koni Store is a Brazilian chain of Japanese fast-food outlets headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. It offers dishes like temakis and sushi and operates 32 stores across four Brazilian states and the Federal District.

kabum.name: KaBuM!
kabum.description: KaBuM! is a Brazilian e-commerce company specializing in electronics and information technology. Founded in Limeira, São Paulo, it sells a wide variety of products including automotive electronics, cosmetics, and musical instruments.

kumba-iron-ore.name: Kumba Iron Ore
kumba-iron-ore.description: Kumba Iron Ore is an iron-ore mining company based in South Africa. It is notable for being the fifth largest iron-ore producer in the world and the largest in Africa.

kunstmann.name: Kunstmann
kunstmann.description: Kunstmann is a Chilean beer brand produced in Torobayo, Valdivia by Compañia Cervecera Kunstmann S.A. The company is led by CEO Armin Kunstmann.

kyriazi-freres.name: Kyriazi freres
kyriazi-freres.description: Kyriazi Freres was a cigarette manufacturing company established in 1873 in Egypt. It was founded by Ioannis Kyriazis and his brothers, who all played active roles in the company. The company operated in the tobacco industry.

karinou-airlines.name: Karinou Airlines
karinou-airlines.description: Karinou Airlines was an airline based in Bangui, Central African Republic. It operated scheduled passenger services to various destinations across Africa.

kivu-air.name: Kivu Air
kivu-air.hq: Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo
kivu-air.description: Kivu Air is an airline based in Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo. It operates charter and cargo services with main bases at Goma International Airport and Bukavu Airport. The airline serves the local area.

karibu-airways.name: Karibu Airways
karibu-airways.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
karibu-airways.description: Karibu Airways is an inactive airline based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It was involved in the aviation industry but is no longer operational.
